name: Twitter/X bearish but price holding — sentiment/price divergence accumulation (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why the divergence leads): when the X crowd is loudly BEARISH but price refuses to fall (ret_Nd holding up or rising), buyers are quietly absorbing all the negative sentiment — a wall of worry that resolves UP. The tell is the DIVERGENCE between mood and tape: persistent bearish social sentiment that price ignores signals informed accumulation the crowd has not recognized, so it leads the eventual re-rating higher. Distinct from the sentiment-washout REVERSION (which needs an RSI oversold price too): here price is NOT weak — it is the resilience against bad mood that is the signal. Exit when sentiment flips positive (the crowd capitulates to the uptrend — thesis realized). DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain 'price holding up' momentum filter matches the deflated Sharpe, the bearish-sentiment arm adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: sentiment often just LAGS price — if replacing bearish-sentiment with bullish-sentiment does as well, there is no divergence edge, only momentum. Requires XAI_API_KEY; tier1, low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: twitter_sentiment is negative (X crowd bearish) yet price is holding/rising (ret_Nd non-negative) — a bullish divergence.
